clue.text: Lively embraces providing calm

indicators.note: to embrace is to hug, so the first word wraps round the second

parts.note: pacy means fast and lively
providing, as a conjunction, means if

explanation.surface: Energetic hugs are a soothing thing to offer.
explanation.definitionFit: To calm someone is to soothe or placate them, a direct verb synonym.

clue.text: Sump is to necessitate purchasing engine part

indicators.note: purchasing in its old sense of gripping, holding, so the words hold the letters

explanation.surface: Buying a sump means you must buy a component for the motor.
explanation.definitionFit: A piston slides in a cylinder of an internal combustion engine, a component.

clue.text: Launches advances holding soldiers caught

indicators.note: holding means the outer word clasps the next pieces

parts.note: comes means approaches, advances
men are soldiers, other ranks
C is the cricket abbreviation for caught

explanation.surface: An army moves forward, keeping troops it has captured.
explanation.definitionFit: To launch something is to start it, so the verbs mean begins.

clue.text: Overseas France beginning to overthrow government

parts.note: F is the international code for France

indicators.note: the beginning of a word is its first letter

parts.note: a reign is rule, a period of government

explanation.surface: Abroad, France is starting to topple its rulers.
explanation.definitionFit: Overseas means abroad, from another country, a synonym in adjectival use.

clue.text: Area like this contains container for plant

indicators.note: contains means the outer pieces hold the next piece within them

parts.note: thus means in this way, like this
a can is a tin container

explanation.surface: A garden zone shaped this way holds a pot for a plant.
explanation.definitionFit: The acanthus is a Mediterranean plant whose leaves inspired Corinthian column decoration.

clue.text: Start to chinwag and have aimless talk

definitions.text: Start to chinwag and have aimless talk

indicators.note: the start of each word is its first letter, taken here from the last four words except the link

explanation.surface: Begin a gossip and natter about nothing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Start to' takes the initials of chinwag, have, aimless and talk; the whole clue also describes the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Idle conversation, gossip or a natter is exactly what a chinwag is.

clue.text: Perfect area to climb missing old country

indicators.note: in a down clue climbing means reading upward, so the letters are reversed

parts.note: A1 means perfect, first class, with the 1 read as I

indicators.note: missing means lacking, so the letter is dropped

parts.note: a region is an area

explanation.surface: An ideal district to scale, lacking anything antique.
explanation.walkthrough: 'missing' drops O from AIREGION, giving AIREGIN, and 'to climb' turns it upside down.
explanation.definitionFit: Nigeria is a West African nation, an example of a country.

clue.text: Described by Mach, a steady velocity

indicators.note: described in the sense of encompassed, enclosed, so the words contain the letters

explanation.surface: A physicist explains steady speed in terms of Mach numbers.
explanation.definitionFit: Haste is speed or rapidity of movement, loosely velocity.

clue.text: Charming activity of bee?

parts.note: casting spells is charming work, and a bee here is a contest in which children write words letter by letter

explanation.surface: What delightful thing does a honeybee do?
explanation.walkthrough: The bee is not an insect but a spelling bee, a contest; charming means working magic.
explanation.definitionFit: Working charms is casting spells, and a spelling bee tests the writing of words.

clue.text: Serious doctor absorbed by wound?

indicators.note: something absorbed by another is taken inside it

parts.note: a sore is a wound, the question mark flagging the loose equation
MB is Bachelor of Medicine, a doctor's degree

explanation.surface: A grave physician soaks up a wound, perhaps while treating it.
explanation.definitionFit: Sombre means grave and gloomy, a synonym for serious in mood.

clue.text: Spending up front, reportedly, showing generosity?

indicators.note: reportedly means as heard said, so the description is spoken

parts.note: the capital at the front of the word Spending is a large ess

explanation.surface: Splashing out cash in advance looks generous.
explanation.walkthrough: The capital first letter of 'Spending' is a 'large S'; said aloud, that phrase gives the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Largesse is generous giving of money or gifts, so it means generosity.

clue.text: Docile old criminal welcomes end

indicators.note: to welcome is to take in, so one word holds the other

parts.note: bent is slang for crooked or criminal
to die is to come to an end

explanation.surface: An elderly crook meekly accepts that his finish has come.
explanation.definitionFit: A docile person is compliant and obeys readily, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Public official never admits to being promoted

indicators.note: admits means lets in, so the word holds the other

parts.note: nary means not any, never a

indicators.note: promoted means raised, in a down clue read upward

explanation.surface: A civil servant never confesses to a promotion.
explanation.definitionFit: A notary public is an official who witnesses documents and signatures.

clue.text: Test gold before transaction

parts.note: or is the heraldic term for gold
a deal is a business transaction

explanation.surface: An assay checks the gold before a sale goes through.
explanation.definitionFit: An ordeal is a severe trial or test of endurance.

clue.text: Applaud using force to apprehend adult

indicators.note: to apprehend is to seize and hold, so one piece encloses another

parts.note: to prise is to force open with leverage
A is the film-certificate abbreviation for adult

explanation.surface: Clapping for police who use force to arrest a grown-up.
explanation.definitionFit: To praise is to commend, so it is a synonym of applaud figuratively.

clue.text: Dismay of criminal's time with Queen and Country

parts.note: a con is a convict, so criminal's gives con plus the S
ER is Elizabeth Regina, the Queen
a nation is a country

explanation.surface: A convict's spell inside, for Queen and Country, is upsetting.
explanation.definitionFit: Consternation is anxious alarm or shock, a synonym for dismay.

clue.text: Same turning, indicate left

indicators.note: turning suggests twisting round, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A driver signals the same way each time: turning left.
explanation.definitionFit: Identical means exactly alike, a synonym of same.

clue.text: Say something wrong seeing girl on top

parts.note: miss is a young girl
a peak is the top of something

explanation.surface: Blurting a gaffe on spotting a girl at the summit.
explanation.definitionFit: To misspeak is to utter an error or misstatement, a mistaken remark.

clue.text: Defiant trade union's bid curtailed undergoing restructure

indicators.note: restructuring rearranges parts, so the pooled letters are reordered

parts.note: union's supplies the letters of union plus S

indicators.note: curtailed means having its tail cut off, losing the last letter

explanation.surface: A rebellious labour organisation's offer is cut short during a reorganisation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'curtailed' cuts BID to BI; TRADE, UNIONS and BI together are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Insubordinate describes someone who disobeys authority, a synonym for defiant.

clue.text: Irritable seeing account not closed over debts

indicators.note: not closed means left open at the end, so the final letter goes

parts.note: a bill is an account of charges
IOUs are written acknowledgments of debts

explanation.surface: Cranky when an account is left open and the debts mount.
explanation.definitionFit: Bilious, from bile, describes a bad-tempered, peevish manner.

clue.text: Piece by piece going topless

indicators.note: topless means without its top, in a down clue the first letter

parts.note: a particle is a tiny piece

explanation.surface: Little by little the clothing comes off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Piece by piece' looks like a single idiom; the first word is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A newspaper piece is a written item for publication.

clue.text: Ships circling large swells

indicators.note: circling means going round, so the first piece surrounds the second

parts.note: boats are ships

explanation.surface: Vessels sail around a big ocean swell.
explanation.definitionFit: To bloat is to puff up, so it means swells as a verb.

clue.text: Outfit with flexibility

definitions.meaning: to outfit is to equip or provide
in a supple, bendy manner, the adverb of supple

explanation.surface: Clothing that bends easily.
explanation.walkthrough: The two senses are pronounced differently: the verb rhymes with 'apply', the adverb ends like 'simply'.
explanation.definitionFit: To equip is to provide stock; the adverb from supple means in a bendy way.

clue.text: Former nosey parker, we hear

indicators.note: we hear means as heard aloud, a homophone

parts.note: a prier is one who pries, a nosey parker

explanation.surface: An ex-busybody, as rumour has it.
explanation.definitionFit: Prior means earlier or previous, so former in time.

clue.text: Sober? Stand almost everybody swallowing short!

indicators.note: swallowing means taking something inside, as in a gulp

parts.note: a tee is the stand a golf ball rests on

indicators.note: almost means not quite whole, so the final letter is dropped

parts.note: all means everybody
a short is a small measure of spirits, a tot

explanation.surface: Can you stay sober when nearly everyone downs a nip of spirits?
explanation.definitionFit: Someone sober in this sense abstains from alcohol entirely, hence the question mark.

clue.text: Family sitting round large oven

indicators.note: sitting round means surrounding, so the first piece encloses the second

parts.note: kin are one's family

explanation.surface: Relatives gather by a big stove.
explanation.definitionFit: A kiln is a furnace for firing pottery or bricks, a kind of oven.

clue.text: Detectives going back on record is nothing irregular

parts.note: an EP is an extended-play record
O looks like zero, nothing

indicators.note: going back means travelling backwards, so the letters are read in reverse

parts.note: CID is the Criminal Investigation Department, British police detectives

explanation.surface: Police investigators returning to the files find nothing out of order.
explanation.definitionFit: Episodic means happening at intervals rather than steadily, so it is irregular.

clue.text: Archaic lilac occasionally produces bush

indicators.note: occasionally means now and then, so only every other letter is taken

explanation.surface: An old-fashioned lilac sometimes yields a shrub.
explanation.definitionFit: Acacia, the wattle, is a thorny shrub or tree, an example of a bush.

clue.text: Field vehicle finally takes red fuel

indicators.note: takes means accepts inside, so the first piece holds the second

parts.note: ken is one's range of knowledge, a field
a rose is a red flower, and rose is a reddish colour

indicators.note: finally points to the last letter of the word after it

explanation.surface: A farm vehicle eventually runs on red diesel, the dyed fuel UK farmers use.
explanation.definitionFit: Paraffin, burned in lamps and jet engines, is a fuel oil.

clue.text: States concerned with welfare

parts.note: re means regarding, concerned with
alms are charitable giving, welfare for the poor

explanation.surface: Governments taking an interest in social support.
explanation.definitionFit: A realm is a kingdom, so realms are states or countries.
